name: Mrs. Chen
description: Elderly woman, going to Riverside Cemetery
personalRule: Hates bright lights - will ask you to dim dashboard
dialogue: It's so cold tonight, isn't it?
I haven't been home in so long...
Thank you for the ride, dear
Why won't you look at me, dear?
backstoryDetails: Mrs. Chen was a regular taxi passenger for 40 years before her accident on this very route...

tells.description: Asks why you won't make eye contact
tells.triggerPhrase: Why won't you look at me

tells.description: Fidgets with old locket when ignored

warning: subtle
critical: moderate

warning: Please... could you just look at me for a moment?
It gets so cold when no one sees me.
critical: Why won't you acknowledge me? I'm right here!
If you keep ignoring me I might fade entirely.
meltdown: Look at me! I refuse to disappear again!

routePreferences.reason: Too many memories on the main roads...
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Please... not the main road. Too many memories there.

routePreferences.reason: The quiet paths remind me of peaceful times
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Oh, the scenic route! How lovely... it reminds me of better days.

routePreferences.reason: Quick paths away from the crowds
routePreferences.specialDialogue: A quiet shortcut... yes, away from all the noise.
So many police cars... it makes me anxious.

name: Jake Morrison
personalRule: Don't ask about his work - becomes agitated
items: business card with no company name
dialogue: Working late again...
Do you mind if I keep the windows up?
Some jobs you just can't talk about
backstoryDetails: Jake works the night shift at a blood bank, though his employment records don't seem to exist...

tells.description: Checks his watch every minute as hunger builds
Mutters about needing to feed soon

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: We really should pick up the pace... daylight is unforgiving.
I can feel the hunger gnawing. Please, a faster route.
critical: If we don't hurry I might lose control.
The thirst is unbearable. Take the alleys - now.
meltdown: Too late. I can't promise your safety any longer!

routePreferences.reason: Police attention is... problematic for my kind
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Not the police route! They ask too many questions...

routePreferences.reason: Dark alleys and back roads suit me
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Perfect. The shadows will hide us well.
So many lights... so many watching eyes.

routePreferences.reason: Acceptable as long as it's not too bright
routePreferences.specialDialogue: This route will do... peaceful enough.

name: Sarah Woods
description: Young woman with dirt under her fingernails
personalRule: Gets nervous if you take highway - prefers back roads
supernatural: Escaped from something in the woods
dialogue: I need to get back to civilization
Stay away from the woods tonight
They might still be following
Don't take the highway, please - they use the main roads
backstoryDetails: Sarah was part of a hiking group that went missing three years ago. She was the only one who 'returned'...

tells.description: Warns against taking main roads
Shows visible panic when approaching highway entrances

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Please, avoid the main roads - they know those paths.
They watch the highways. Take the back roads, I beg you.
critical: If you follow the GPS we are dead. Turn now!
I can hear them in the wires. We have to change course!
meltdown: Too late - they found us through the lights!

routePreferences.specialDialogue: Yes! Take the back roads - they won't find us!
Not the main road! They'll see us!
Police... they ask too many questions.
This route is quiet at least.

name: Dr. Hollow
personalRule: Will offer medical advice - don't accept treatment
supernatural: Former doctor who lost license for unethical experiments
dialogue: House calls are so rare these days
I can help with any pain you're feeling
Medicine has come so far since my day
Please, I need to stop - someone might need medical attention!
backstoryDetails: Dr. Hollow lost his license in 1987 for conducting unauthorized experiments on terminal patients...

tells.description: Insists on stopping to help with medical emergencies
Constantly checking medical equipment in bag

routePreferences.specialDialogue: The back roads... yes, discretion is appreciated.
Not past the police station! My license... there are complications.
The standard route will suffice.
Ah, the scenic route. Peaceful... contemplative.

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Something in the bag needs attending to. Soon.
You would not want it to spoil in your back seat.
critical: Pull over. I am not asking twice.
Do you smell that? That is a schedule being missed.
meltdown: Then we do this here, in traffic, with the meter running.

name: The Collector
personalRule: Will try to buy things from your car - don't sell anything
supernatural: Trades in supernatural artifacts and souls
dialogue: I see you have interesting items
Everything has a price
I make excellent deals
backstoryDetails: The Collector has been making deals in this city for over a century, always offering what people need most...

ruleModification.description: Can remove one rule in exchange for a terrible price

routePreferences.specialDialogue: Ah yes, the scenic route. I do appreciate the finer things.
The normal route. Efficiency has its value.
A shortcut? How... crude.

routePreferences.reason: They know better than to stop me
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The police know better than to interfere with my business.

warning: subtle
critical: moderate

warning: You carry something interesting. I can hear it.
Everything on that seat has a price. Name one.
critical: Give it to me. I will make it worth the night.
You are wasting what you do not understand.
meltdown: Then I take it the old way, and you keep the change.

tells.description: Prices the contents of your cab aloud
Eyes settle on whatever you are carrying

name: Tommy Sullivan
description: Child in school uniform, shouldn't be out this late
personalRule: Don't ask about his parents - becomes very quiet
supernatural: Lost child who doesn't realize he's been missing for decades
dialogue: Is mommy waiting for me?
I don't like the dark
Teacher said I should go straight home
Why won't anyone look at me? Am I being bad?
backstoryDetails: Tommy went missing from school in 1982. His backpack was found, but he never was...

tells.description: Asks why no one will look at him
tells.triggerPhrase: Why won't anyone look at me

tells.description: Voice trembles with increasing distress

routePreferences.specialDialogue: I don't like this way! It's too scary and dark!
This is the way I usually go home from school.

routePreferences.reason: Police officers make children feel safe
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Look! Police cars! They keep us safe from bad people!

routePreferences.reason: Longer routes make children anxious to get home
routePreferences.specialDialogue: This is taking too long... I want to go home to mommy.

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Is my mum still at the house on Ferris Street?
Nobody has talked to me in a really long time.
critical: Why will nobody answer me? I have been so good.
Please do not stop talking. It gets dark when you stop.
meltdown: I do not want to be lost again! Look at me!

name: Elena Vasquez
description: Dancer in vintage dress, speaks with old accent
personalRule: Requests specific songs - humming along will break silence rule
supernatural: 1940s nightclub performer who died in a fire
dialogue: The music never stops playing in my head
I had the most wonderful audition tonight
Do you know any Glenn Miller?
Please, I can't breathe - there's too much smoke in here!
Could you open a window? The air is so thick...
backstoryDetails: Elena was the star performer at the Moonlight Club before the fire of 1943 claimed 30 lives...

tells.description: Complains about smoke and thick air
Coughing and gasping, touching throat frequently
Panics when looking at closed windows

routePreferences.specialDialogue: Oh, the scenic route! It reminds me of when I was alive...
These streets... I remember them from before.
Not the dark alleys! It reminds me of... that night.

routePreferences.reason: They never found who started the fire
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The police... they never found who started the fire.

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Could you crack a window? The air in here is thick.
It smells like smoke to you too, does it not?
critical: I cannot breathe. Please, the window, please.
It is getting hot. Tell me it is not getting hot.
meltdown: Let me out! It is burning again, it is burning again!

name: Marcus Thompson
description: Jogger in athletic gear, constantly looking over shoulder
personalRule: Keeps asking you to drive faster - accepting will violate route rules
supernatural: Runner who encountered something supernatural in the woods
dialogue: Did you see that behind us?
We need to go faster!
I should have listened to the locals
Talk to me, please - the silence is making me paranoid!
We need to take a shortcut - they know the main roads!
backstoryDetails: Marcus was training for a marathon when he took a wrong turn into the old growth forest...

tells.description: Begs for conversation to calm paranoia
Constantly looking over shoulder with terror
Urgently requests shortcuts to avoid main roads

routePreferences.specialDialogue: Yes! The shortcuts! Fast and hidden!
Police route... safety in numbers, right?
Not the main road! Too exposed!

routePreferences.reason: Too slow! We need to move!
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Too slow! We need to move faster!

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Do not slow down through here. Please just do not slow down.
Did you see something on the treeline? Tell me you did not.
critical: Keep talking. If you stop talking I will hear it instead.
It followed me out of the woods. It follows.
meltdown: Drive! Do not look at the mirror, just drive!

name: Nurse Catherine
description: Hospital nurse in stained scrubs, very tired
personalRule: Will offer to check your pulse - accepting triggers medical rule violation
supernatural: Overworked nurse who made a fatal mistake
dialogue: Another long shift ending
Some mistakes you can never take back
The patients keep calling my name
Please, just talk to me - I can't handle the silence right now
I need to stop - I feel sick, really sick
backstoryDetails: Catherine accidentally administered the wrong medication to a patient during a 36-hour shift...

tells.description: Desperately asks for conversation to escape guilt
Shows signs of severe nausea and distress
Clutching medical clipboard with trembling hands

routePreferences.specialDialogue: The scenic route... quiet helps me think about what I did.
Just... just get me there.
Not a shortcut... rushing is what caused my mistake.
Not past the police station! What if they investigate?

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: I only need a moment. I have somewhere I should have been.
Room 4. It is always room 4 when I close my eyes.
critical: Stop the car. Someone is waiting and I am late again.
I could have fixed it. I had the chart in my hand.
meltdown: Let me go back! I can still fix the chart!

name: Old Pete
description: Fisherman with wet clothes despite no rain
personalRule: Insists on keeping windows down - conflicts with sealed windows rule
supernatural: Drowned fisherman who refuses to accept his fate
dialogue: The fish are really biting tonight
Haven't seen water this calm in years
My boat's just around the corner
backstoryDetails: Pete's boat was found capsized during a storm in 1995, but his body was never recovered...

routePreferences.specialDialogue: Ah, the scenic route... reminds me of the water.

routePreferences.reason: The old routes I used to take
routePreferences.specialDialogue: These are the old routes I used to take to the docks.
No need to rush... rushing leads to mistakes.

routePreferences.reason: Never had trouble with the law
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Never had trouble with the law in my day.

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Bit close in here. Mind the window, skipper?
Tide is wrong tonight. You can taste it.
critical: I need the air. I have needed the air a long while.
The boat is still moored. She is still moored, is she not?
meltdown: I am not going under again! Open it! Open it!

tells.description: Calls you skipper and asks after the tide
The footwell is wet and stays wet

name: Madame Zelda
description: Fortune teller with knowing eyes and crystal jewelry
personalRule: Will read your future - listening reveals upcoming rule violations
supernatural: Psychic who sees too much of what's coming
dialogue: I see danger in your immediate future
The cards never lie about tonight
Some knowledge comes with a price
backstoryDetails: Zelda's predictions are always accurate, but her clients rarely survive long enough to appreciate her gift...

ruleModification.description: Reveals one hidden rule to the player

routePreferences.reason: The spirits speak clearer on quiet roads
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The scenic route... the spirits speak clearer here.

routePreferences.reason: I see the path others miss
routePreferences.specialDialogue: A shortcut? I see the path others miss.
All roads lead somewhere, driver.

routePreferences.reason: They fear what they don't understand
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Police... they fear what they don't understand.

warning: subtle
critical: moderate

warning: Take the next left. Do not ask me why yet.
I have already seen how this ride ends. Twice.
critical: You did not listen. Now there are fewer endings left.
Please. I can only see the road you do not take.
meltdown: It has already happened! It has already happened!

tells.description: Gives you a direction before you reach the junction
Flinches at turns you have not made yet

name: Frank the Pianist
personalRule: Hums haunting melodies - will test your no music rule
supernatural: Jazz musician who made a deal for talent
dialogue: Music is everything to me
I'd give anything to play again
Some contracts last forever
backstoryDetails: Frank sold his soul for incredible musical talent, but the devil's price was higher than expected...

routePreferences.specialDialogue: The scenic route... beauty still inspires music in me.
Steady rhythm, like a metronome. I appreciate that.
Sometimes speed is needed in performance.
Police... too much scrutiny for my liking.

warning: moderate
critical: obvious

warning: Hum it with me. Just the one bar, driver.
I wrote it. Whatever he says, I wrote it.
critical: Sing it. You owe me that much for the fare.
He is owed since forty-nine and he does not forget.
meltdown: Then he collects from you instead! Sing it!

tells.description: Presses you to hum a melody you do not know
Fingers a keyboard that is not there, leaving marks

name: Sister Agnes
description: Nun with ancient texts and worried expression
personalRule: Offers to bless your car - accepting may conflict with supernatural passengers
supernatural: Nun investigating supernatural occurrences in the city
dialogue: Evil walks freely tonight
Faith is our only protection
Some souls cannot be saved
Let me bless this car against what rides tonight
backstoryDetails: Sister Agnes is one of the few living people who knows the truth about the city's supernatural residents...

routePreferences.reason: Law and order protect the innocent
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The police route. Law and order protect the innocent.
The normal route. The righteous path is always clear.
God's creation is beautiful, even at night.
Shortcuts often lead to sin, child.

warning: subtle
critical: moderate

warning: Would you accept a blessing? It costs you nothing.
I have been in three cabs tonight. Yours is the quiet one.
critical: Take it. I am not certain I can carry it much further.
Something followed me out of the last house.
meltdown: Take the blessing! I cannot hold it alone!

tells.description: Offers a blessing more insistently each mile
Works the rosary faster than she is speaking

name: Detective Morrison
description: Tired detective with case files and coffee stains
personalRule: Asks probing questions about other passengers - answering reveals rule violations
dialogue: Strange things happen on the night shift
I've seen some unexplainable cases
Every taxi driver has stories
backstoryDetails: Detective Morrison specializes in cases other officers won't touch - missing persons who were never really missing...

routePreferences.specialDialogue: Police route. Professional courtesy, you understand.
Normal route. By the book, as it should be.
A shortcut. Sometimes necessary in this line of work.
Scenic route wastes time. Time is evidence.

warning: subtle
critical: moderate

warning: You work these streets nightly. You have seen things.
Humour me. What did you pick up on Ferris last month?
critical: Do not get careful on me now. Answer the question.
Twelve drivers. Twelve. And you are the one still talking.
meltdown: Pull over. You are going to tell me everything.

tells.description: Asks the same question in three different shapes
Writes down your answers without looking at the pad

name: The Midnight Mayor
description: Impossibly tall figure in formal attire from another era
personalRule: Commands you to break specific rules - obeying leads to immediate consequences
supernatural: Ancient entity that governs the supernatural side of the city
dialogue: Welcome to my city
Rules are made to serve those who matter
Your compliance is... appreciated
backstoryDetails: The Midnight Mayor has ruled the supernatural side of the city since its founding, making deals and collecting debts...

ruleModification.description: The Midnight Mayor can impose a new rule during your shift

newRule.title: Mayor's Decree
newRule.description: Follow all commands from city officials without question

routePreferences.reason: I built these streets, I'll enjoy them
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The scenic route. I built these streets, I shall enjoy them.
Police route. My servants patrol well.
All roads in this city are mine, driver.
A shortcut? Haste shows disrespect.

warning: subtle
critical: obvious

warning: This is my city, driver. You are a guest in it.
Take the route I name and the night stays civil.
critical: You were told. Being told is the courtesy you get once.
I have unmade streets for less than this.
meltdown: Then the city takes it back, and you with it.

tells.description: Names a route as though it were already law
Streetlights hold green wherever he is looking
Speaks of the route as a decision already taken

name: Death's Taxi Driver
description: Figure in dark robes who speaks in whispers
personalRule: Offers to trade places with you - accepting ends the game immediately
supernatural: The reaper who collects souls of failed night shift drivers
dialogue: Your shift is almost over
Every driver meets me eventually
Some debts can only be paid with time
We could trade places. You could finally rest
backstoryDetails: The previous night shift taxi driver, who failed the rules one too many times and now serves as death's chauffeur...

routePreferences.reason: The shortest path to the end
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The shortcut. The shortest path to the end.
The scenic route. I have all eternity, after all.

routePreferences.reason: All roads lead to me eventually
routePreferences.specialDialogue: All roads lead to me eventually, driver.
Police cannot stop death.

warning: subtle
critical: obvious

warning: You have driven a long shift. I could shorten it.
Twelve before you took the offer. It is not a cruel one.
critical: The meter runs both ways tonight, driver.
Say yes and you never have to make this turn again.
meltdown: Then I will simply wait at the end of the street.

tells.description: Counts the drivers who came before you
No breath fogs the glass beside him
The meter reading does not change between blocks

name: Mara Bell
description: A midnight bellhop carrying a ring of keys that open rooms the hotel no longer has
personalRule: Never let the room keys ring - silence keeps the hotel from following
supernatural: Bellhop who died waiting for a guest who never arrived
dialogue: Room seven is still waiting for its guest.
Please keep the keys quiet until we reach the station.
The elevator stopped between floors again last night.
I have carried this case farther than anyone remembers.
backstoryDetails: Mara worked the graveyard desk at the Grand Hotel until a guest rang from a room that had burned down decades earlier. She took the call, carried the key upstairs, and never came back down.

tells.description: The key ring trembles whenever the cab passes a hotel sign
Corrects the driver when a room number is spoken aloud
The rear-view mirror briefly reflects a hotel corridor instead of the road

warning: subtle
critical: moderate

warning: The keys are getting restless. Please, no sudden turns.
critical: You are making the hotel look for us. Keep driving.
meltdown: The doors are open now. Something has checked in.

routePreferences.reason: Steady roads keep the keys from waking
routePreferences.specialDialogue: A steady road. The keys prefer that.

routePreferences.reason: Sharp turns make every key ring
routePreferences.specialDialogue: No shortcuts. The keys do not like being hurried.

routePreferences.reason: The long road passes fewer doors
routePreferences.specialDialogue: The long road is kind. Fewer doors that way.

routePreferences.reason: Patrol lights wake the hotel bell
routePreferences.specialDialogue: Please turn away from the lights. They make the bell ring.
